cohort: A cohort of women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) who delivered singletons between 2017 and 2021.
finding: Despite early GDM women exhibiting more severe GDM features, including higher BMI and insulin requirements, there were no substantial differences in most pregnancy complications compared to late GDM, apart from early GDM being independently associated with preeclampsia and abnormal glucose tolerance after delivery.
